quote: We test our method on extractive question answering (QA) and natural language inference (NLI). …

Metrics In addition to calibration accuracy (ACC) that measures the accuracy of the calibrator, we also use the area under coverage-F1 curve (AUC) to evaluate the calibration performance for QA tasks.
We train a random forest classifier, shown to be effective for a similar data-limited setting.
Our evaluation focuses on binary calibration, or classifying whether a model's initial prediction is correct.
